service_boundary: Represents Mistral AI Studio, formerly La Plateforme, not Le Chat, open-weight downloads, self-deployed models, or partner-served Mistral endpoints.
regional_controls: Deployment and residency commitments vary between the hosted platform, enterprise arrangements, and partner-served deployments; the reviewed public docs do not support one universal region claim.
retention_controls: Data handling depends on account tier, feature, and governing commercial terms; stateful platform features must be reviewed separately from stateless model calls.
routing: Customers select models in the Mistral-hosted catalog; partner-served deployments are a distinct contractual path.
customization: Fine-tuning and agent-building paths are documented for eligible models and accounts.
strengths: A European-operated direct platform spans proprietary and open model families.
The platform includes model APIs, tuning, OCR, audio, and agent services.
tradeoffs: The broad platform includes features with different storage behavior.
Partner-hosted and customer-infrastructure deployments have separate terms and boundaries.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Mistral API reference, for Mistral AI Studio

upstream_disclosure.note: The public trust centre's subprocessor list names the infrastructure parties per product, including "Microsoft Inc. • Cloud Infrastructure Sweden, Norway Products: Vibe, Studio / AI" and "Google LLC • Cloud Infrastructure Netherlands, Belgium, United States (US API endpoint) Products: Vibe, Studio/API (US API)", and the privacy policy covers Mistral AI Studio by name.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Mistral trust centre subprocessor list, for Mistral AI Studio

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: the quickstart's first step is "Navigate to API Keys in the left sidebar. Click Create new key." in the Studio console, and every documented request uses that key.
credential_handling.scope: Mistral AI Studio API-key quickstart, for Mistral AI Studio

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching page documents the feature and its billing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the organisation that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: Mistral AI Studio prompt-caching page, for Mistral AI Studio

vulnerability_disclosure.note: A security.txt file is published with a contact address ("Contact: mailto:security@mistral.ai") and a HackerOne submission policy.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Mistral security.txt, for Mistral AI Studio

independent_audit.note: The public trust centre lists ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and SOC 2 Type II for the company, with certificates and a report behind a request-access control; nothing states that the attestations cover Mistral AI Studio or the API, so it is recorded as undocumented for the named service.
independent_audit.scope: Mistral trust centre compliance section, read for Mistral AI Studio

findings.claim: Mistral AI Studio API files input filtering and access restriction: "A lack of filtering on the API /api/files can let a malicious user access unattended resources." Affected: Mistral AI Studio and le-chat; remediation: "Update to Mistral AI Studio 2026.1.3, 2026.2.0, or later."

operator_response.summary: The operator published the advisory itself, naming the affected products and the fixed releases.

resolved.summary: Fixed in Mistral AI Studio 2026.1.3 and 2026.2.0 per the advisory.
